description: This file contains the implementation of patching and configuration operations for Realtek RTL826XB PHY devices, including functions for waiting on register values, setting and getting top, SDS, and PHY registers, and applying patches via various flow sequences. It also includes initialization of patch databases tailored to different hardware configurations.

methods.name: uint16 _phy_rtl826xb_mmd_convert(uint16 page,uint16 addr)
methods.description: Converts a page and address into an internal register address for MMD access.

methods.name: int32 _phy_rtl826xb_patch_wait(uint32 unit,rtk_port_t port,uint32 mmdAddr,uint32 mmdReg,uint32 data,uint32 mask,uint8 patch_mode)
methods.description: Polls a register until it matches specific data or timeout occurs.

methods.name: int32 _phy_rtl826xb_patch_wait_not_equal(uint32 unit,rtk_port_t port,uint32 mmdAddr,uint32 mmdReg,uint32 data,uint32 mask,uint8 patch_mode)
methods.description: Polls a register until it does not match specific data or timeout occurs.

methods.name: int32 _phy_rtl826xb_patch_top_get(uint32 unit,rtk_port_t port,uint32 topPage,uint32 topReg,uint32 * pData)
methods.description: Reads a value from a top register given page and register numbers.

methods.name: int32 _phy_rtl826xb_patch_top_set(uint32 unit,rtk_port_t port,uint32 topPage,uint32 topReg,uint32 wData)
methods.description: Writes a value to a top register given page and register numbers.

methods.name: int32 _phy_rtl826xb_patch_sds_get(uint32 unit,rtk_port_t port,uint32 sdsPage,uint32 sdsReg,uint32 * pData)
methods.description: Reads SDS register value via top registers.

methods.name: int32 _phy_rtl826xb_patch_sds_set(uint32 unit,rtk_port_t port,uint32 sdsPage,uint32 sdsReg,uint32 wData,uint8 patch_mode)
methods.description: Writes SDS register value via top registers.

methods.name: int32 _phy_rtl826xb_flow_r1(uint32 unit,rtk_port_t port,uint8 portOffset,uint8 patch_mode)
methods.description: Executes a specific sequence of register writes and waits for flow 1.

methods.name: int32 _phy_rtl826xb_flow_r12(uint32 unit,rtk_port_t port,uint8 portOffset,uint8 patch_mode)
methods.description: Executes a sequence of register operations for flow 12.

methods.name: int32 _phy_rtl826xb_flow_l1(uint32 unit,rtk_port_t port,uint8 portOffset,uint8 patch_mode)
methods.description: Executes a flow sequence involving setting PCS state.

methods.name: int32 _phy_rtl826xb_flow_l2(uint32 unit,rtk_port_t port,uint8 portOffset,uint8 patch_mode)
methods.description: Executes a flow sequence involving setting PHY registers to zero and waiting for state change.

methods.name: int32 _phy_rtl826xb_flow_pi(uint32 unit,rtk_port_t port,uint8 portOffset,uint8 patch_mode)
methods.description: Detailed flow involving multiple register manipulations for patching process.

methods.name: int32 _phy_rtl826xb_flow_n01(uint32 unit,rtk_port_t port,uint8 portOffset,uint8 patch_mode)
methods.description: Flow sequence for patch type N01.

methods.name: int32 _phy_rtl826xb_flow_n02(uint32 unit,rtk_port_t port,uint8 portOffset,uint8 patch_mode)
methods.description: Flow sequence for patch type N02.

methods.name: int32 _phy_rtl826xb_flow_n11(uint32 unit,rtk_port_t port,uint8 portOffset,uint8 patch_mode)
methods.description: Flow sequence for patch type N11.

methods.name: int32 _phy_rtl826xb_flow_n12(uint32 unit,rtk_port_t port,uint8 portOffset,uint8 patch_mode)
methods.description: Flow sequence for patch type N12.

methods.name: int32 _phy_rtl826xb_flow_n21(uint32 unit,rtk_port_t port,uint8 portOffset,uint8 patch_mode)
methods.description: Flow sequence for patch type N21.

methods.name: int32 _phy_rtl826xb_flow_n22(uint32 unit,rtk_port_t port,uint8 portOffset,uint8 patch_mode)
methods.description: Flow sequence for patch type N22.

methods.name: int32 _phy_rtl826xb_flow_s(uint32 unit,rtk_port_t port,uint8 portOffset,uint8 patch_mode)
methods.description: Flow sequence for SDS-related patching.

methods.name: int32 phy_rtl826xb_patch_op(uint32 unit,rtk_port_t port,uint8 portOffset,rtk_hwpatch_t * pPatch_data,uint8 patch_mode)
methods.description: Performs specified patch operation based on provided data structure.

methods.name: int32 phy_rtl826xb_patch_flow(uint32 unit,rtk_port_t port,uint8 portOffset,uint8 patch_flow,uint8 patch_mode)
methods.description: Dispatches the patch flow sequence based on flow type.

methods.name: int32 phy_rtl826xb_patch_db_init(uint32 unit,rtk_port_t port,rt_phy_patch_db_t ** pPhy_patchDb)
methods.description: Initializes patch database with configuration based on hardware detected.

methods.name: int32 phy_rtl826xb_patch(uint32 unit,rtk_port_t port,uint8 portOffset)
methods.description: Applies initial patch data to PHY device.

methods.name: int32 phy_rtl826xb_broadcast_patch(uint32 unit,rtk_port_t port,uint8 portOffset,uint8 perChip)
methods.description: Applies patch data with broadcast mode either per-chip or per-bus.

methods.name: int32 _phy_rtl826xb_flow_r2(uint32 unit,rtk_port_t port,uint8 portOffset,uint8 patch_mode)
methods.description: unavailable
